purpose: Synthetic stand-in for the real 2021-2022 test window, used only to demonstrate how the frozen M0 model scores, alerts and is evaluated. Not observed data and not evaluation evidence.

bootstrap.method: calendar-aligned half-year block bootstrap of monthly real-price log returns
bootstrap.blocks: H1 = Jan-Jun returns, H2 = Jul-Dec returns; each synthetic half-year is drawn with replacement from the same half of a pool year, so harvest seasonality is kept.

anchor.note: The synthetic path starts from the real December 2020 price and uses real 2020 prices only as feature history (all pre-test).

test_origin_mask: Real M4_features_complete origins from the eligibility file between test_start and the last origin whose 3-month outcome window ends by 2023-01.
